title: Ottawa 200th Anniversary Landmarks
includes: new Giant pathway bicycle, helmet, water, professional and experienced guide. Ebikes are available
Route: may change according to flooding, construction, community events, Capital events (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We have a large selection of tandems, ebikes and bikes for all ages and abilities that are fitted for each persons needs and preferences..
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Celebrate Ottawa's 200th ( and our 50th) Anniversary with us.

Since 1976, we have offered the original and unique landmarks bike tour for visitors to the Nation's Capital. 
Senior guide Robert family goes back to the 1830's and is exclusive to Ottawa. He presents and unique, original and entertaining narrative unavailable elsewhere. Many lovely sights, some unique history and always an anecdote about our community and inhabitants to raise a smile.
We use only pathways. There is no traffic or roads to traverse.
Our Giant bicycles and helmets are new every year. Please ask for an Ebike upgrade.
